6a.

Pursuant to Chapter 20 of the Acts of 2021 and in order to
ensure active, public engagement, the City of Worcester
currently allows for both in-person and remote participation at
all City Council and Standing Committee meetings. To partake
in the "Public Participation" section of the meeting, you may
attend the meeting in-person within the meeting location, follow
the below link to join via Zoom or dial the direct line as
indicated. If you join a Zoom meeting by dialing in with a phone
number, you can raise your hand by dialing *9.

9.

8e.

Councilor Jose A. Rivera on behalf of Heather Flavin
request installation of a dynamic speed monitor display on
May St. between Chandler St. and Pleasant St.

Attachments

8f.

Councilor Gary Rosen on behalf of several residents in the
Hadwen Park and Stafford St. area request installation of
two (2) signs at both the entrance of the Shaw s parking lot
at 68 Stafford St. and at the entrance of Heard St. alerting
motorists to the fact that the area is a crossing frequently
used by flocks of water fowl, especially ducks, crossing
Stafford St. while waddling to the nearby park and water
body.

Attachments

humps in the vicinity of 173 Ingleside Ave.

Attachments

10. ORDERS

10a. Request City Manager request Commissioner of Public
Works complete immediate emergency repairs of the
sidewalk on the odd side of Lovell St. in front of the
Columbus Park Preparatory Elementary School, located at
75 Lovell St. (see attached). (Rivera)

Attachments

10b. Request City Manager request Police Chief provide
increased enforcement of double-parking violations from the
intersection of Chino Ave. and Boylston St. westward on
Boylston St. towards Pasadena Pkwy., in the interest of
public safety. (Economou)

Attachments

10c. Request City Manager request Police Chief provide
increased enforcement related to the public consumption of
alcohol in the vicinity of 8 Boylston St. (Economou)

Attachments

11. COMMUNICATIONS OF THE CITY CLERK

the administration and operations of the City Council Office.

Attachments

11b. Transmitting an informational communication concerning
the process required for City Council to hire and oversee
City Council Office Staff.

Attachments

11c. Transmitting an informational communication regarding the
City Council Office staff's implementation of a new
employee mileage-tracking process when conducting official
city business.

12. COMMUNICATIONS
12a and 12b Adopt on a roll call

12a. Kristi L. Turgeon, Clerk of the School Committee,
transmitting a request for the City Council to authorize the
Worcester Public Schools (WPS) and City of Worcester to
approve an easement to National Grid for property situated
on the southerly side of Thorndyke Road School, located at
30 Thorndyke Rd.

Attachments

12b. Eric D. Batista, City Manager, recommend adoption of a
resolution to file and accept an in-kind grant from the
Massachusetts Department of Transportation (MassDOT) of
one (1) All-Way Stop Control (AWSC) signs set.

14. REPORTS OF THE COMMITTEE ON VETERANS' MEMORIALS,
PARKS AND RECREATION
14a and 14b Accept and Adopt

14a. REPORT OF THE COMMITTEE ON VETERANS'
MEMORIALS, PARKS AND RECREATION Upon the
Petition of Maureen Schwab request installation of "Green
Island Neighborhood Center" signage with a directional
arrow pointing to the building at the Crompton Park parking
lot entrance on Canton St., in an effort to mitigate difficulty
locating the center: recommend adoption of the
accompanying Order.

Attachments

14b. REPORT OF THE COMMITTEE ON VETERANS'
MEMORIALS, PARKS AND RECREATION Upon the
Petition of Councilor Satya B. Mitra on behalf of the Green
Island Neighborhood Group request installation of No
Alcohol Allowed, No Loud Music, and Park Closed at 10
p.m. signage at Crompton Park, at its entrance on Canton
St.: recommend adoption of the accompanying Order.

Attachments

14c - 14g Accept

14c. REPORT OF THE COMMITTEE ON VETERANS'
MEMORIALS, PARKS AND RECREATION Upon the
Communication of the City Manager transmitting
informational communication relative to the Veteran
Services Division's efforts to the recognize Worcester
residents who served in WWII, but are not currently
commemorated: recommend Communication be placed on
file.

Attachments

14d. REPORT OF THE COMMITTEE ON VETERANS'
MEMORIALS, PARKS AND RECREATION Upon the
Communication of the City Manager transmitting
informational communication relative to the changes to the
consumption and sale of alcoholic beverages in municipal
parks policy for special and sporting events: recommend
Communication be placed on file.

Attachments

14e. REPORT OF THE COMMITTEE ON VETERANS'
MEMORIALS, PARKS AND RECREATION Upon the
Communication of the City Manager transmitting
informational communication relative to the review of eight
conceptual designs for the Elm Park Master Plan:
recommend Communication be placed on file.

Attachments

14f.

REPORT OF THE COMMITTEE ON VETERANS'
MEMORIALS, PARKS AND RECREATION Upon the Order
of Councilor John P. Fresolo - Request City Manager work
with the Commissioner of Parks, Recreation, and Cemetery
to provide City Council with a report concerning the best
practices for the management of invasive plant species.
Said report should include best practices for the
management of invasive plant species that are located on
City properties, as well as the feasibility of developing a
public awareness campaign that informs private property
owners on how to identify and manage invasive plant
species on their property: recommend Order be placed on
file.

Attachments

14g. REPORT OF THE COMMITTEE ON VETERANS'
MEMORIALS, PARKS AND RECREATION Upon the
Petition of Maureen Schwab request installation of Visitor
Parking signage with an arrow on Canton St. at the
Crompton Park parking lot entrance to inform park patrons
of available parking and mitigate resident permit parking
violations: recommend Petition be placed on file.

Attachments

15. HELD UNDER PRIVILEGE

15a. ORDER of Councilor Jose A. Rivera - Request City Auditor
provide City Council with a report detailing a full financial
audit and accounting of both the completed and currently
underway work being done at the Beaver Brook Dog Park.
(Held Under Privilege - Rivera June 16, 2026)

Attachments

16. TABLED ITEMS

16a. ORDER of Councilor Konstantina B. Lukes - Request City
Manager request City Solicitor provide City Council with a
legal opinion regarding the process of instituting a
residential rent control program and the resulting impact of
implementing such a program. (Held Under Privilege -

Attachments

Lukes September 17, 2019 and September 24, 2019 and
Tabled - Lukes October 15, 2019)

16b. RESOLUTION of Councilor Khrystian E. King - That the City
Council of the City of Worcester does hereby support
Representative Rebecca Rauch and Senator Sonia ChangDiaz s SD 699 HD 1283, An Act effectuating equity in
COVID-19 Vaccination Bill. (Held Under Privilege - Bergman
February 9, 2021 and Tabled - Bergman February 23, 2021)

Attachments

16c. ORDER of Councilor Etel Haxhiaj and Councilor Thu
Nguyen - Request City Manager work with appropriate
departments and stakeholders to establish an Office of
Housing Stability in an effort to prevent the involuntary
displacement of city residents who are in the process of
being evicted or at the risk of losing their housing, as well as
to enact policies to combat displacement, homelessness
and enhance tenants rights. (Held Under Privilege - Haxhiaj
July 18, 2023 and Tabled - Haxhiaj August 22, 2023)

Attachments

16d. PETITION of Gordon Davis request City Council request
Standing Committee on Public Safety investigate the issue
of systemic racism and public safety with public hearings
included. (Tabled - Toomey May 14, 2024)

Attachments

16e. ORDER of Councilor Khrystian E. King - Request City
Manager conduct an equity audit of all city departments
every five (5) years. (Held Under Privilege - Mero-Carlson
December 10, 2024 and Held Under Privilege - Toomey
December 17, 2024 and Tabled - Nguyen January 7, 2025)

Attachments

16f.

Attachments

COMMUNICATION of the City Manager transmitting
informational communication relative to how the U.S.
Department of Justice's report on the Worcester Police
Department differs from the account of the municipality.
(Held Under Privilege - King April 29, 2025 and May 6, 2025
and Tabled - King May 13, 2025)

17. BUSINESS UNDER SUSPENSION OF RULES - Items brought
forth under suspension at the June 16, 2026 City Council
meeting.

17a. ORDER of Councilor Satya B. Mitra Request City Manager
provide City Council with a report regarding a timeline to
implement improvements at the DCU Center. Item #18a CC
Order adopted on a roll call vote of 8 Yeas and 1 Nay

17b. ORDER of Councilor Gary Rosen Request City Manager
request Commissioner of Parks, Recreation and Cemetery
review the authorized swimming area at Binienda Beach,
formerly known as Coes Pond Beach, for the purpose of
safely expanding said area for beach patrons to have a
deeper and larger area to swim. Item #18b CC Order
adopted

17c. ORDER of Councilor Satya B. Mitra Request City Manager
request Commissioner of Transportation and Mobility provide
City Council with a report listing and outlining each street in
the city that is considered a principal arterial street. Item
#18c CC Order adopted

17d. ORDER of Councilor Morris A. Bergman Request City
Manager request Commissioner of Transportation and
Mobility provide City Council with a report detailing how
many additional miles of bicycle lanes will be installed in the
city in 2026. Item #18d CC Order adopted

17e. ORDER of Councilor Satya B. Mitra Request City Manager
request Commissioner of Transportation and Mobility review
the intersection of Highland St., Main St. and Grove St. for
the purposes of making improvements to the location that
ensure motorists do not block the intersection at the location.
Item #18e CC Order adopted

17f.

ORDER of Councilor Satya B. Mitra Request City Manager
provide City Council with opportunities in public meetings to
discuss budgetary priorities prior to presenting future Annual
Operating and Capital budgets. Item #18f CC Order adopted
on a roll call vote of 11 Yeas and 0 Nays

17g. ORDER of Councilor Khrystian E. King Request City
Manager provide City Council with an update concerning a
previously adopted order on September 17, 2024, which

read as follows: Request City Manager request City Solicitor
provide City Council with a legal opinion and any draft
documentation required to begin the process of changing the
City Charter and City Council Rules, if necessary, to grant
City Council the authority to move, edit and/or eliminate any
line item/funding listed in the City Budget by a majority vote
during the annual budgeting process. Item #18g CC Order
adopted on a roll call vote of 10 Yeas and 0 Nays

17h. ORDER of Councilor Khrystian E. King Request City Clerk
provide City Council with a report concerning the process
used by Boston to adopt a Special Act allowing for their City
Council to hold new budgetary powers, including the
authority to amend budgetary line items. Item #18h CC
Order adopted on a roll call vote of 10 Yeas and 0 Nays

17i.

RESOLUTION of Councilor Khrystian E. King That the City
Council of the City of Worcester does hereby support
thoroughly exploring the feasibility of increasing its authority
over the process used to pass and create the budget of the
city. Item #18i CC Resolution adopted on a roll call vote of
10 Yeas and 0 Nays
